source.title: Final Moments in Cassini Mission Control

transcription.method: Editorial reconciliation of independent audio transcriptions, JPL webpage transcript and embedded EIA-608 captions
transcription.modelAccess: Gemini and GPT Audio through OpenRouter; Scribe and forced alignment through ElevenLabs
transcription.timing: Scribe v2 acoustic word timestamps; general audio models’ segment timestamps rejected as inaccurate. ElevenLabs forced alignment was attempted but denied due to missing forced_alignment permission; no independent alignment result was available.
transcription.speakerAttribution: Julie Webster and Earl Maize named by JPL captions and webpage. Their short exchange is assigned by diarization and conversational continuity. ACS 1 and the signal operator have no verified personal names.
decisions: Opening: ACS one, we just had transition to high rate mode (captions and Scribe; webpage has condition).
11.179–12.500 seconds: [unintelligible]; candidates include X-band/X-ray band and S-band/Sierra band/C-band. No consensus; JPL also marks this unintelligible.
Retain Okay, the individually spoken digits one one five five four six, and audible uh fillers from Scribe.
Retain Project manager on FSO coord, Maybe a trickle, within the next, and gonna from acoustic recognition instead of the edited webpage wording.
After but, Scribe and GPT Audio hear just heard; Gemini and the webpage disagree on additional pronouns. Retain just heard and document the uncertainty.
Preserve full audio including final applause; do not assign group applause to Earl Maize or turn unspoken closing-credit captions into speech.
transcription.limitations: AI-reconciled transcript, not a human-certified or official NASA transcript. Word boundaries and short-turn speaker assignments remain estimates.

audio.processing: Full original stereo audio, no cuts or denoising in listening copy; AAC decoded and encoded as 48 kHz stereo Opus at 96 kb/s. Filtered radio crop used only for transcription comparison.
